iterations_to_convergence.label: Convergence rate: iterations to convergence (initial search)

note: Path cost is the CRITIC ten-feature cost of each road when entered, for both algorithms. Convergence rate = iterations until the initial search first found its final best route. Traffic is modeled, not measured. Lower is better for every measure.
